newsitem.title: USA: On Command, SpectraVision get satellite capacity.
newsitem.headline: On Command, SpectraVision get satellite capacity.

text.p: On Command Corp and SpectraVision Inc said they have secured satellite capacity which will allow them to restore those SpectraVision pay movie services affected by the unexpected failure of AT&T's Telstar 401 satellite.
Restoration of service, which requires repointing of the satellite dishes at the subject hotels, will begin this week and is expected to be completed within several weeks.
On Command said it has not yet concluded its determination of the effect on the company's earnings arising from the loss of Telstar 401.
The outage affected approximately 980 hotels, nationwide, it said.
